purpose: Two compile-only horizon measurements and one bounded output-selection comparison; no solve execution or numerical qualification.

fixture.source: .tickets/cff-a3wz.md, criterion 7 and frozen formula; indices t=0..T-1, i,j=0..3, l=0..2; L=T-1
fixture.construction: Evaluate formulas in NumPy float64, round once into stored float32 arrays; no JAX float64 values. Broadcast fixed transition arrays over L.
fixture.parameter_xi: zeros [L,K,K-1]; replaced by the solver coordinate
fixture.initialization: existing unperturbed feasible initializer inside complete solve, compiled but never executed

policy.source: qualified Y15D defaults, tests/fixtures/hybrid-joint-candidate-spec.json strategy; no restarts or tuning
policy.thresholds: unchanged production tolerance(dtype) = 64*eps(dtype)**0.75; compile-only evidence makes no convergence claim
policy.static_metadata: Coordinate support, origins, active/gauge/auxiliary index maps; identical fixed layout per T; no dynamic parameter values captured
policy.inference_semantics: Select fields only after the unchanged complete solver returns. Auxiliary/learning finiteness remains a status dependency. This is not a no-learning mode.
policy.reporting_excluded: Physical learning conversion, NumPy export and recovery fitting are absent from both programs. Full means the native complete solver State, including centered learning arrays and beliefs.

runtime.persistent_cache: disabled via config; XLA auxiliary caches disabled; record actual settings and compiler logs
runtime.processes: one fresh subprocess per case, sequential, no repeats; stop sequence on first failure/resource stop
runtime.reuse: Retain Lowered and Compiled objects through reporting. Never call Compiled. No cross-process executable reuse, timing warm-up or recovery start.
runtime.timing: perf_counter_ns; lower() and compile() separately, dtype/IR/memory inspection outside both timers; compile() is executable acquisition
runtime.memory: XLA estimates separate from logical leaves and process memory; parent os.wait4 child ru_maxrss gives independent process high-water (Darwin bytes, Linux KiB). ps rss is a sampled current-RSS diagnostic in KiB, not a phase peak.
runtime.internal_dtypes: Check floating leaves in arguments/fixed metadata/lowered and compiled output descriptors, and all StableHLO operand/result/block-argument element types. No runtime internal arrays or terminal results are observed.
runtime.cache_evidence: Record compiler log and actual disabled settings. Exactly one lower/compile call per process; no full-program in-process reuse is requested. OS/compiler internals may still reuse resources; no repeated-execution speed claim.

limits.policy: Diagnostic soft limits, not allocation guarantees; transient RSS can exceed the sampled limit. Terminate the process group, then kill after grace; preserve logs, samples, last worker checkpoint and wait4 high-water. No automatic retry or continuation.

interpretation.scope: Two measured horizons, no asymptotic fit. Compare compiler outputs and storage estimates, not numerical accuracy or optimizer runtime.
interpretation.current_users: Unbound D12 has no public compiler/Engine activation; existing public D9 compilation remains independent. D12 holds parameters fixed and does not perform recovery fitting.
interpretation.costs: Shape/static-layout changes can require compilation; compatible dynamic inputs could reuse an executable. Repeated parameter fitting adds inference executions. Moderate execution timing is still needed to assess amortization.
interpretation.limits: Recovery quality remains unestablished. Dropping learning-finiteness checks, changing xi updates, objectives or certification changes failure/inference semantics and is outside this experiment.
